LESSON: COMMUNICATION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
Topic 3.5: Communication in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Communication in Eastern Africa, part of Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How could communication network influence development of our country?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Communication in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: learners’ role play scenarios that depict the different modes of communication in Eastern Africa.

• Learning to learn: learners work collaboratively discuss in pairs, the challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa.

Values:
● Respect: learners are open mindedness as they brainstorm, in pairs, and state challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa.

● Unity: learners discuss the challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social cohesion: learners role play scenarios that depict the different modes of communication in Eastern Africa.

• Safety and Security: learners research on challenges facing communication networks in Eastern Africa

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Pre-technical studies: learners relate to knowledge and skills acquired in Pre- technical studies as they discuss solutions to challenges

facing communication networks in Eastern Africa.

• English/Kiswahili/Kenya sign language: learners apply language skills in English, Kiswahili and Kenya sign language as they role play

scenarios that depict the different modes of communication in Eastern Africa.

Suggested Learning Resources

Print and electronic maps, posters, internet sources, vetted digital resources, adapted learners’ books and other printed resources, resource

persons, newspaper cuttings,
